params.name: platform_id
params.description:
The unique platform identifier. 

Prefix is "plt" in production and "sbx_plt" in sandbox.

params.name: merchant_id
params.description:
The unique merchant identifier. 

Prefix is "mid" in production and "sbx_mid" in sandbox.

params.name: name
params.description: Optional merchant name by which to search merchants.

params.name: status
params.description:
One or more merchant statuses to filter by. Provide parameter multiple times to filter by multiple merchant status types. 

`ACTIVE` `DEACTIVATED` `ONBOARDING` `PENDING` `SUSPENDED`

params.name: billing_profile_id
params.description: Optional billing profile ID by which to search merchants.

params.name: created_at.start
params.description: Created on or after in UTC RFC 3339 format.

params.name: created_at.end
params.description: Created on or before in UTC RFC 3339 format.

params.name: updated_at.start
params.description: Last updated on or after in UTC RFC 3339 format.

params.name: updated_at.end
params.description: Last updated on or before in UTC RFC 3339 format.

params.name: latest_merchant_application_status
params.description: One or more merchant application statuses to filter by. Provide parameter multiple times to filter by multiple merchant application status types.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Optional value by which to sort the result set. Default sort by is created_at.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Order in which to return the sorted results; ascending or descending. Default sort order is descending.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of results to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the first result to return; zero-based.

items.docs: Query a list of merchants given optional search criteria.
Create a merchant with an initial merchant application.

params.name: merchant_id
params.description:
The unique merchant identifier. 

Prefix is "mid" in production and "sbx_mid" in sandbox.

items.docs: Get merchant details by the merchant ID.
Update supported fields on a merchant. Only fields included in the payload will be updated. Omitted fields will not be updated. Merchant status must be `ACTIVE`.
Cancel a pending merchant. Merchant status must be `PENDING`.
Update the billing profile assigned to a merchant.
